subject: Proposed 4-week trial & evaluation template — BeaconRx
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Jennifer Yang <jennifer.yang@beaconrx.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed 4-week trial and evaluation template

Hi Jennifer —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Great to learn more about BeaconRx's medication reconciliation workflow and the high-volume ingestion you described. Per our call, I wanted to capture a concise next-steps plan so your team can review and we can lock dates. I attached a short evaluation template (redwood_eval_template.xlsx) that maps success criteria to test cases and owner responsibilities.

High-level proposal (can adjust based on your availability):
- Week 0 (prep, access): account setup, sample data upload, SSO + IP allowlisting, brief kickoff with your SRE and Maxwell (CTO)
- Week 1 (integration): ingest subset of inpatient med lists, run baseline inference, verify latency and token-cost targets
- Week 2 (quality tests): run 200 annotated prompts from your error log, measure precision/recall vs. baseline, capture qualitative issues
- Week 3 (iteration & optimization): tuning (prompt templates, batching, KV caching), apply quantization profile for cost targets
- Week 4 (wrap & handoff): outcomes review, decision checklist, exec summary for procurement

Proposed success criteria (from our call):
- Precision >= 92% on reconciliation task across 3 representative departments
- 95th percentile latency < 350ms for in-memory inference for typical 512-token sequences
- Cost per 1K tokens reduces by >= 25% vs. current hosted endpoint after batching/quantization
- Automated regression tests added to your CI for the top 50 prompts

Owners (suggested):
- Redwood: Dylan (AE) — commercial & timeline, Monica (Solutions Eng) — integration and runbook
- BeaconRx: Maxwell (CTO) — infra + SSO, Jennifer (Product) — quality sign-off

Attached items: evaluation template, draft SOW for scope/pricing, procurement starter doc with expected legal/PO items. Can we aim to start Week 0 on Monday 2027-04-12? If that looks good I’ll share a short kickoff calendar invite and loop in our infra engineer.

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
D: (415) 555-0187 | dylan@redwood.com

Dylan —

Appreciate the clear rundown and the template. A couple quick notes from our side:
- Maxwell wants a slightly longer prep window for network approvals — can we shift Week 0 start to 2027-04-19?
- For the success criteria, can you add an example of the automated regression test harness you recommend? Our team currently uses pytest + a simple fixtures layer; seeing a concrete example will help us scope the integration work.
- Procurement asked for estimated cost bands in the SOW (ballpark monthly committed cost vs. on-demand). Can Monica include a 2-tier pricing example?

Also copying Maxwell — he’ll be the technical approver for infra items. Procurement will ping separately (procurement@beaconrx.com) with their standard vendor onboarding form.

Thanks,
Jennifer Yang

- Pricing bands: Monica will include a 2-tier committed vs on-demand table in the SOW-draft (attached).

I’ll prepare the kickoff invite for Tuesday 2027-04-20 (slotted for 30 minutes) — will include Monica for the technical portion and Lauren for success criteria tracking and reports.

Best,
Dylan
